description: Text transform on cells in column EmergencyService using expression value.toUppercase()

expression:
jython:import re
   import string

   # Remove punctuation, convert to lowercase, and split on whitespace
   value = re.sub(r'[%s]' % re.escape(string.punctuation), '', value).lower().split()

   # Join the words back together with spaces and capitalize the first letter of each word
   value = ' '.join([word.capitalize() for word in value])

   # Check if the standardized hospital owner name matches "Voluntary Non-Profit - Private" or "Voluntary Non-Profit - Other"
   if value == "Voluntary Non-Profit - Private" or value == "Voluntary Non-Profit - Other":
       return "Yes"
   else:
       return "No"
return value
